output.summary: A perennial pea native to Europe and parts of Asia. It has dark root tubers and red flowers that become bluer with age. The tubers can be eaten raw but are better cooked like chestnuts; they were historically eaten in the Scottish Highlands during food shortages.
output.edibilityNote: Tubers are edible raw but preferably cooked like chestnuts; they were historically eaten during Scottish Highland food shortages and used to suppress appetite.
